title: [test] bare-bd durability probe
description: Verification probe: filed via BARE bd (no beads-safe wrapper), then a full sync cycle runs. If this bead survives the cycle intact, bare bd writes are durable (bead biod follow-up).
close_reason: Verification passed: filed via bare bd, survived a full sync cycle including branch merges (c1683827c4) — bare bd writes are durable. Residual rewinds audited: one leftover unconditional 'git checkout -- .beads' on the kimi-abort path found and removed (sync-beads-workers.sh:149, would have eaten writes made during a failed single-file kimi session). Both fleet scripts now have zero unconditional .beads rewinds. Residual risk unchanged: process-level RMW race on the same bead file (unobserved, bd has internal locking) and the hook's BEADS_ALLOW_STORE_COMMIT escape hatch.
